title: Central read-only hardcoded configuration candidate discovery

phases.objective: Discover hardcoded configuration candidates from the central repository inventory scope without modifying code, database, protected refs, or secrets.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Runtime settings, policy candidates, secret candidates, and generated artifacts are classified deterministically; sensitive values are redacted; the manifest forbids automatic application.
steps: Scan tracked source and configuration files while excluding tests, fixtures, generated artifacts, dependencies, and snapshots.
Detect environment references, configuration-like declarations, migration seeds, and policy-like symbols.
Classify candidates by setting, policy, secret, generated artifact, or manual review category.
Redact sensitive values and emit deterministic JSON, Markdown, and review manifest artifacts.
Assert that repository mutation, database mutation, protected-ref mutation, and automatic migration generation are all disabled.
assertions: The scanner is registered as a read-only maintenance tool.
No raw secret value is included in any candidate, evidence, preview, or manifest output.
Generated artifacts are excluded from migration proposals.
The manifest contains no approved candidates and explicitly disables automatic apply.
The tool does not write to runtime configuration tables or activate write scopes.

phases.objective: Publish reviewed candidate reports through the central repository automation evidence path without enabling automatic migration or runtime mutation.
Generate database migration candidates only after explicit classification, schema validation, secret review, parity evidence, and owner approval.
The discovery tool cannot authorize write scopes or Production mutations.
